Who We Are
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
 The opportunity
 If you are an engineer who enjoys turning loosely defined requirements into reliable automated tests, and who learns new tools quickly, we want to hear from you.
The Core Foundation & Integration Tribe (CFI) implements and delivers the Issuing core applications, from Card Issuing lifecycle to Transactions clearing & settlement. With over 150 million cards and 1.16 billion monthly transactions, our platforms operate at the forefront of capacity and performance.
We are now seeking a QA Automation Engineer to help us build fast, reliable test automation for our Issuing platforms and contribute to our strategic product transformation.
You will join a dynamic, co-located team of tech leads, developers and testers. You will automate end-to-end business scenarios on our custom-built testing framework and help keep our core applications reliable throughout the whole development lifecycle.
 Day-to-day Responsibilities
Build and maintain automated test suites on our custom-built testing framework, extending it with new keywords and libraries where needed.
Clarify what matters in features with limited context, then turn them into automated coverage using the existing framework or another suitable tool.
Automate end-to-end scenarios that span REST APIs, messaging flows and databases, from quick smoke tests to full regression suites.
Write maintainable Python code, Robot Framework tests and Shell scripts that prepare test data, set up environments or run suites.
Take part in code reviews and keep CI/CD pipelines green by fixing flaky tests at the root cause.
Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to work faster and improve code quality.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts and tech leads to understand new features early.
Share what you learn with the team and suggest ways to improve how we test.
 Who Are We Looking For
 We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:
Degree in a scientific field and 3+ years of hands-on test automation experience, with a software engineering mindset that goes beyond test scripting.
Hands-on experience with Python, Robot Framework and Shell scripting (sh/bash).
Experience with REST API testing, SQL databases, Git and CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI.
Practical experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) in day-to-day work.
Fast learner who ramps up on an existing framework, picks the right tool for the job and delivers working automation with little context.
Strong analytical and debugging skills, with attention to edge cases; Scrum experience is a plus.
Experience in the payments industry, including credit card schemes (Visa, Mastercard) and the credit card lifecycle, is a plus.
ISTQB certification is a plus.
Excellent written and spoken English (C1); additional languages (French, German, Italian) are appreciated.
 Perks & Benefits
 At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:
Hybrid Working Policy
Gift vouchers on the occasion of Christmas/Easter Holidays
Private medical services
21 vacation days/year
Referral bonuses for new hires recommended by you
WFH & Flexible Working Hours
Full access to the “Learning” platform
 Shape the evolution 
 We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
